profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Energetic and strongly attached to familiar people, Feists tend to bring an intense hunting interest to daily outings. They use sight, sound and scent to find small game, often following a track quietly. This varied Southern American family includes several breeds and strains, developed for hunting, pest control and companionship.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Feists combine strong family bonds with energetic small-game hunting, using sight, sound and scent along a quiet track.
